description: List the end users of an app: everyone who ever called it with X-App-User or signed in to it with a code. Each has userId (the id link_app_user, list_app_user_links and send_test_push take), externalId (the developer's own id for them, or null for a user who signed in by code), name, source (api or otp), role (viewer, editor or submitter; editor when never set), isActive, lastSeenAt and itemCount (rows they own on the app's boards). Use it to find the userId of the person to link to a row.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: list_app_users
